capacity_claims.quote: **Dallas, TX – September 10, 2024** – [DataBank](https://www.databank.com/), a leading provider of enterprise-class edge colocation, interconnection, and managed services, today announced the development of a 480MW data center campus on 292 acres of land in Red Oak, TX, dramatically expanding its capacity and ability to meet growing demand for data center space and power being driven by A.I.

The Phase 1 design of the site will feature 4 buildings and a 400MW sub-station from Oncor that can deliver up to 240MW of critical IT power with the ability to increase this in Phase 2 for a total of 480MW across all 8 buildings.
